title: A deep learning-based approach to diagnose mild traumatic brain injury using audio classification
summary: A particle-swarm-optimized Bi-LSTM-A classified speech features from a pilot rugby-athlete dataset, reporting AUROC 0.904, sensitivity 94.7% and specificity 86.2% for mild traumatic brain injury. The small study dataset limits generalization and does not establish clinical utility.
ai_technology: A particle-swarm-optimized bidirectional LSTM with attention classifies speech MFCC features for mild traumatic brain injury.
organization: Department of Computer and Information Sciences, Northumbria University, Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
